_doc: Session settings and the dated calendar the Legislative Log reads. Dates are verified against the source named on each row; the steward re-checks them and adds the 2027 calendar when the Legislature adopts it (normally early December). `stalledAfter` is the last day for each house to pass bills in the second year; after it an in-process bill cannot advance.

calendar.label: Last day for each house to pass bills
Last day for the Governor to sign or veto bills
calendar.note: A bill passed before Sept 1 and not returned by Sept 30 becomes law without his signature (Cal. Const. art. IV, sec. 10(b)(2)).

calendar.label: 2027-28 session convenes
calendar.note: Noon on the first Monday in December of an even year (Cal. Const. art. IV, sec. 3(a)).

calendar.label: Most 2026 statutes take effect
calendar.note: Non-urgency statutes take effect January 1 of the following year (Cal. Const. art. IV, sec. 8(c)).
